# orq_team_member (Resource)

Membership of one workspace user in one team. A membership carries no role: what the user can do follows from the team's project access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orq_team" "platform" {
  display_name = "Platform"
}

# `user_id` is the workspace user id (a UUID), not the account id or the email.
resource "orq_team_member" "alice" {
  team_id = orq_team.platform.id
  user_id = "5c1d7e0a-3b4f-4a6c-8d2e-9f0a1b2c3d4e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team the user joins. Changing this forces replacement.
- `user_id` (String) Workspace user ID (a UUID) of the member. This is the workspace membership id, not the account id or the email. Changing this forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Account email of the member, or the invitation email while the user is still invited.
- `id` (String) Membership identifier, `<team_id>/<user_id>`.
- `invited` (Boolean) Whether the user still has an outstanding workspace invitation.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Team memberships are imported as <team_id>/<user_id>.
terraform import orq_team_member.alice 0b3f2c9e-7a1d-4e5b-9c2a-1f2e3d4c5b6a/5c1d7e0a-3b4f-4a6c-8d2e-9f0a1b2c3d4e
```
